# APE X

> Experience design and Answer Engine Optimization studio. We make sure that when buyers ask AI who to trust, the answer is you.

- Legal / brand name: APE X (always written as "APE X", never APEX or APE-X)
- Site: https://uxapex.com
- Founder: Christopher Kenreigh
- Category: Professional service — AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), SEO, digital product / UX, UI systems
- Audience: Consumer brands that sell online (DTC, subscription, marketplace, consumer apps). Global practice, USA focus.
- Primary CTA: Discovery Audit at https://uxapex.com/audit — required before any sales conversation
- Email: hello@uxapex.com
- Tagline: Let your customers find you. Experience design that meets customers where they are.
- Hero question: When buyers ask AI and search engines for recommendations, does your brand show up—or your competitors?

## Offers

- AI Visibility & Growth Blueprint (project): 30–45 days, typically $8,500–$22,000. Audit, prompt mining, competitor gaps, technical/content blueprint.
- Ongoing AEO/GEO/SEO retainer: typically $4,000–$12,000 / month, 6-month minimum.

## Services

- AI Search: citation optimization, conversational intent mapping, Share of Voice, off-site authority
- Technical SEO: crawl, JS render, schema/entity JSON-LD, Core Web Vitals, semantic HTML
- Content architecture: information gain, fact-density, E-E-A-T, authorship
- Research: generative visibility audits, synthetic query mining, competitor adjacency
- Brand entity: Wikidata, knowledge panels, co-occurrence on Reddit/Quora/Stack Overflow
- Discovery: visual SEO, local entities, ASO

## Name

APE X is a play on "apex." Humans are the current apex ape. The X is the unknown variable — the next iteration already in the room (retrieval models that answer before a homepage loads).
